column1: # The reviewed exceptions of synth_warning_gate.py (ble-tx-min, AdvData in the memory and in flip-flops): tool <TAB> the whole warning line (a regular expression) <TAB> why it stays.
# Every other warning of the synthesis (Vivado, Yosys) or of the layout (LibreLane) fails the gate.

column2: WARNING: \[Synth 8-7129\] Port (s00_axi_arprot|s00_axi_awprot)(\[\d+\])? in module btle_controller is either unconnected or has no load
column3: btle_controller's interface (kept): the AXI4-Lite protection signals, which this slave ignores, as every AXI4-Lite slave without protection levels

column2: WARNING: \[Synth 8-7129\] Port (bram_en_a|bram_rst_a|bram_we_a|bram_wrdata_a)(\[\d+\])? in module btle_controller is either unconnected or has no load
column3: btle_controller's interface (kept): the PS side of the IQ-capture BRAM, of which the PS only reads (its write, enable and reset are unused)

column2: WARNING: \[Synth 8-7129\] Port (tap_index|tap_value)(\[\d+\])? in module (gauss_filter|btle_gauss_tail) is either unconnected or has no load
column3: a configuration's port: with GAUSS_TABLE = 1 (the final transmitter) the Gaussian taps are constants and these writes are not read; GAUSS_TABLE = 0 (the branch's default, upstream's runtime FIR) reads them

column2: WARNING: \[Synth 8-7129\] Port (gauss_filter_tap_index|gauss_filter_tap_value)(\[\d+\])? in module gfsk_modulation is either unconnected or has no load
column3: the same configuration's port, one level up: gfsk_modulation passes the tap writes to gauss_filter and btle_gauss_tail, which read them with GAUSS_TABLE = 0 only

column2: WARNING: \[Synth 8-7129\] Port otp_prog(\[\d+\])? in module adv_pdu_buffer is either unconnected or has no load
column3: a configuration's port: with ADV_ADDRESS_OTP = 0 (the ROM: the FPGA and the 45 nm runs) AdvA is the parameter ADV_ADDRESS; with ADV_ADDRESS_OTP = 1 (the ASIC) it programs the six eFuse blocks

column2: WARNING: \[Synth 8-7129\] Port otp_prog(\[\d+\])? in module tag_pdu_buffer is either unconnected or has no load
column3: a configuration's port: with ADV_ADDRESS_OTP = 0 (the ROM: the FPGA and the 45 nm runs) AdvA is the parameter ADV_ADDRESS; with ADV_ADDRESS_OTP = 1 (the ASIC) it programs the six eFuse blocks

column2: WARNING: \[Synth 8-7129\] Port (rx_unique_bit_sequence|rx_channel_number|rx_crc_state_init_bit|rx_i_signal|rx_q_signal|rx_pdu_octet_mem_addr)(\[\d+\])? in module btle_phy is either unconnected or has no load|WARNING: \[Synth 8-7129\] Port rx_iq_valid in module btle_phy is either unconnected or has no load
column3: the senseworks tag (ble-tx-tag-*): no receiver; btle_phy keeps the RX ports of the controller's interface (and of the FPGA's block design), its outputs 0, these inputs unused

column2: WARNING: \[Synth 8-7129\] Port read_enable in module pdu_buffer_ram is either unconnected or has no load
column3: the memory's port (AdvData in the memory): the GF180MCU SRAM's wrapper drives the macro's CEN with it (scripts/layout/tx_min_gf180/pdu_buffer_ram_gf180.v); the RTL's model reads in every clock, and adv_pdu_buffer samples its data only in the clock after a read

column2: WARNING: \[DRC 23-814\] Not all possible \(connectivity based\) DRCs may have been run because this design is seen as Out of Context\.
column3: the tool, out of context: the DRCs that need the device's IOs do not run; inherent to an out-of-context implementation (no pins)

column2: WARNING: \[Constraints 18-8777\] Unable to split tiles\. All required files are not available\.
column3: the tool's installation: the router lacks device data files for splitting tiles (Vivado 2026.1 on this machine); not the design

column2: WARNING: \[Synth 8-7129\] Port (tx_gauss_filter_tap_index|tx_gauss_filter_tap_value|tx_cos_table_write_address|tx_cos_table_write_data|tx_sin_table_write_address|tx_sin_table_write_data|tx_preamble|tx_access_address|tx_crc_state_init_bit|tx_crc_state_init_bit_load|tx_channel_number|tx_channel_number_load|tx_pdu_octet_mem_data|tx_pdu_octet_mem_addr|tx_start)(\[\d+\])? in module btle_phy is either unconnected or has no load
column3: ble-tx-poc-tmp100: the Link Layer's TX registers, kept for the controller's interface: tag_fsm drives the transmitter

column2: WARNING: \[Synth 8-7129\] Port rst in module tag_pdu_buffer is either unconnected or has no load
column3: ble-tx-poc-tmp100: a configuration's port: only the eFuse blocks use it (ADV_ADDRESS_OTP = 0)

column2: \[DRT-0349\] LEF58_ENCLOSURE with no CUTCLASS is not supported\. Skipping for layer Via[1-4]
column3: the PDK's technology LEF: a LEF58 enclosure rule the detailed router does not support (it skips it; the foundry's DRC deck checks the enclosures, 0 errors)

column2: \[STA-1140\] /src/gf180mcu/gf180mcuD/libs\.ref/(gf180mcu_fd_sc_mcu7t5v0|gf180mcu_fd_ip_sram)/lib/\S+\.lib line \d+, library \S+ already exists\.
column3: the PDK: 3 liberties (ss, tt, ff) for the 9 signoff corners (each with 3 RC extractions), so STA reads a library a second time for another corner

column2: \[STA-1140\] /out/macros/efuse_array_async_1x8/efuse_async_mem_1x8/\S+/efuse_async_mem_1x8__\S+\.lib line \d+, library efuse_async_mem_1x8 already exists\.
column3: the eFuse compiler: its liberties of efuse_async_mem_1x8, one per corner, all name the library efuse_async_mem_1x8, so STA reads the name again for each corner

column2: 'VSRC_LOC_FILES' was not given a value, which may make the results of IR drop analysis inaccurate\. If you are not integrating a top-level chip for manufacture, you may ignore this warning, otherwise, see the documentation for 'VSRC_LOC_FILES'\.
column3: btle_tx is a macro, not a chip: its supplies come from the chip's grid (the flow's own advice: ignore it then); the IR drop is reported from the macro's pins

column2: Cell 'btle_tx' has \(\d+\) input pin\(s\) without antenna gate information\. They might not be connected to a gate\.
column3: btle_tx is a macro: its input ports drive gates through its own cells; the antenna information of its abstract is the chip's to check, at chip level

column2: Netlists found for macro (efuse_async_mem_1x8|gf180mcu_fd_ip_sram__sram64x8m8wm1), but no parasitics extraction found at corner \S+\. The netlist cannot be used for timing on this module\.
column3: the macros come with their liberties and no parasitics for their netlists (the eFuse compiler's blocks, GlobalFoundries' SRAM): they are timed by their liberties (STA_MACRO_PRIORITIZE_NL off)

column2: \d+ Magic DRC errors found\.
column3: AdvData in the SRAM: Magic's deck rejects GlobalFoundries' own layout of the SRAM; every error lies inside it (run.sh's check, magic_drc_sram.txt) and the foundry's KLayout deck gives 0

column2: Cell 'tag_chip' has \(\d+\) input pin\(s\) without antenna gate information\. They might not be connected to a gate\.
column3: ble-tx-poc-tmp100, no eFuse: the production port of AdvA's eFuse blocks, on the pins of tag_chip, which that configuration does not have; its 48 inputs reach no gate

column2: magic__drc_error__count
column3: as the line above: the errors inside the GlobalFoundries SRAM only, the foundry's KLayout deck 0 on the whole GDS

column2: design__max_fanout_violation__count
column3: clock-tree buffers only: the max fanout of 10 is LibreLane's setting for the PDK (the liberty sets none); every data net meets it, and CTS's sink clustering (7 flip-flops over 150 um) leaves a few tree buffers above it, with every transition and capacitance within the liberty's limits
